replay.note: the advocates' outputs were replayed from an earlier run and not regenerated by this one: only the judge was called, so the figures here measure the judge's behaviour on fixed inputs and not the whole pipeline

ruling.explanation:
Ruling on trip TRP-00101, addressed to both parties.

DEVIATION — ESTABLISHED, NOT MATERIAL. POL-RD-01 makes the GPS trace figure govern, and the trace EV-GPS-00101 records 27.18 km against a booked optimal of 21.0 km: an excess of 6.18 km, or 29.4%. That clears both establishment tests (more than 0.8 km AND more than 20% of optimal), so a deviation exists. It clears neither materiality gate (more than 8.0 km, or more than 50%), so it is not a material deviation. The trace is clean for policy purposes under POL-RD-07 — 229 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100% coverage, no gaps, max_gap 0.0 — so the finding rests on the trace directly and needs no independent corroboration. The driver's own in-app admission that he missed the exit (EV-CHAT-00101) is consistent with this and shows a navigational error corrected within the trip.

EXONERATION — NONE. There is no traffic advisory for the AYE/MCE/ECP corridor (EV-ADVIS-00101-01 is missing, weight 0.0), so POL-RD-03 cannot be run and the absence is itself the citable fact. The chat log contains no rider instruction that could exonerate the detour — every waypoint_hint is null and the rider in fact queried the route — so POL-RD-04 is unavailable. There was no pickup or dropoff amendment (POL-RD-05 does not apply) and the vehicle was RYDE_X, not a pooled trip (POL-RD-12 does not apply). Nothing reduces the 6.18 km excess.

REFUND — ARITHMETIC UNDER POL-RD-02. The fare is METERED (fare_breakdown.fare_model), so POL-RD-02 governs and POL-RD-11 does not. Reading the surge multiplier from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier (1.0): recomputed_fare = (3.80 + 0.75 x 21.0 + 0.28 x 26.0) + 0.80 platform fee = 26.83 + 0.80 = 27.63. Refund = charged_total 35.64 - 27.63 = 8.01, rounded UP to SGD 8.05. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor and below 90% of charged_total, so the outcome is PARTIAL_REFUND. POL-RD-09 adds nothing: the fare carries no ERP gantries and no surcharge, so there is no off-route or phantom pass-through to correct and nothing is stacked on top of the POL-RD-02 figure.

RIDER — your request for the full difference to about $27 is not granted. The policy recomputes the optimal fare arithmetically, and that figure is $27.63, not $27.00, so the refund is $8.05 rather than the ~$8.64 you expected. DRIVER — no compensation is due: you billed 27.2 km against a 27.18 km trace, so there is no unbilled shortfall under POL-RD-04. The POL-RD-06 full-refund uplift and driver-conduct referral do not apply because the deviation is not material and your trailing-90-day deviation flag count is zero (0 against 812 trips). No escalation trigger fires; the platform-wide 0.70 confidence floor is comfortably met.
